description: This file contains a test class for verifying journal entries and transaction behavior related to loan charge-offs and reversals in the Apache Fineract project. It performs integration testing of loan operations such as disbursement, payments, charge-offs, refunds, and reversals, focusing on the accounting entries generated during these processes.

classes.name: LoanChargeOffAccountingEntriesForReverseReplayedTransactionsTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class extending BaseLoanIntegrationTest, designed to test various loan transaction scenarios including charge-offs, reversals, refunds, and associated journal entries, within the Apache Fineract accounting system.

methods.name: testJournalEntriesForChargeOffLoanWithMultipleReverseReplayedTransactions
methods.description: Main test method that simulates a loan lifecycle with multiple transactions, reversals, charge-offs, refunds, and verifies the generated accounting entries at each step.
